legend: You are at a 1$$$1$$$ dollar supermarket where there are n$$$n$$$ sub-shops, each second a new customer comes in every shop, inititally all of them are empty$$$\bf {\text{inititally all of them are empty}}$$$.
Since this is a 1$$$1$$$ dollar supermarket there is only one worker. Each second this worker chooses uniformaly randomly a shop and serves all it's customers instantly.

To do some savings the boss doesn't hire extra workers unless all$$$\bf{\text{all}}$$$ the shops are all floaded. That is if we denote the number of customers of the i−$$$i-$$$th shop to be ai$$$a_i$$$.
Then the shops are floaded whenever forall i∈[1,n],ai≥bi$$$i \in [1, n], a_i \ge b_i$$$ for some pre-fixed bi$$$b_i$$$.
- Extra constraints : $$$\bf{\text{Extra constraints : }}$$$ we assume that b1=0$$$b_1 = 0$$$.
One may prove that the shops will be floaded almost certaintly, your task is to calculate the expected time at which the boss will have to hire extra workers.

It can be shown that the answer can be represented as PQ$$$\frac{P}{Q}$$$, where P and Q are coprime integers and Q≢0$$$Q \not \equiv 0$$$ mod 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$. Print the value of P⋅Q−1$$$P\cdot Q^{-1}$$$ mod 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
input: The first line of the input you will be given 1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$ the number of shops.
The second line of the input contains n$$$n$$$ space separated integers b1,...bn(0≤bi≤1018)$$$b_1, ... b_n (0 \le b_i \le 10^{18})$$$ and b1=0$$$b_1 = 0$$$.
output: Output a single integer the expected time at which the boss will have to hire extra workers modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.

legend.ai: 你来到了一家 1$$$1$$$ 美元超市，里面有 n$$$n$$$ 个分店。每秒钟每个分店都会进来一位新顾客，初始时所有分店都是空的$$$\bf {\text{inititally all of them are empty}}$$$。
由于这是一家 1$$$1$$$ 美元超市，因此只有一名工作人员。每秒钟，这名工作人员会等概率随机选择一个分店，并立即服务该分店的所有顾客。
为了节省开支，老板不会雇用额外的工作人员，除非所有$$$\bf{\text{all}}$$$ 分店都已爆满。也就是说，设第 i−$$$i-$$$ 个分店的顾客数量为 ai$$$a_i$$$。
对于某些预先固定的 bi$$$b_i$$$，当对于所有 i∈[1,n]，均有 ai≥bi$$$i \in [1, n], a_i \ge b_i$$$ 时，所有分店就都算是爆满。

可以证明，几乎必然会出现所有分店爆满的情况。你的任务是计算老板需要雇用额外工作人员的时间的期望值。
可以证明，答案可以表示为 PQ$$$\frac{P}{Q}$$$，其中 P 和 Q 是互质整数，且 Q≢0$$$Q \not \equiv 0$$$ mod 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$。输出 P⋅Q−1$$$P\cdot Q^{-1}$$$ mod 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 的值。

input.ai: 输入的第一行给出 1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$，表示商店的数量。
